sections.title: BOARD CONTROL
rows: Steer and lean. With the Southpaw preset, the sticks trade jobs.
Flick-It: every pop, flip and shove-it starts here.

sections.title: POP
rows: Pull the right stick down, then flick it straight up.
Push the right stick up, then flick it straight down.

sections.title: FLIPS AND SHOVE-ITS
rows: Pull down, then flick diagonally up. Left or right picks which flip, and it mirrors with your stance.
Pull down, then flick sideways. The direction sets the spin.

sections.title: GRABS
rows: In the air, hold LT or RT (left or right hand), then move the right stick to choose the grab.

footer: Directions depend on stance (regular or goofy), so check them in game. To fix or extend this list, edit android/app/src/main/assets/panel/tricks.json and rebuild.
